steps: Create a free Zindi account and open the AI4D Baamtu Datamation Wolof ASR competition page.
Read the competition rules (teams of up to four; open-source packages only; no automl; no metadata use).
Download the provided audio data and build an automatic speech recognition model for Wolof.
Submit prediction files (maximum 10 submissions per day, 300 total) and track the public leaderboard.
Before close, select 2 submissions to be judged on the private leaderboard; if in the top 20, respond to the code-request email within 48 hours.
